description: DigiColosseum NPCs and optional quests, part three.

english: Congratulations, Legend Master! Your team's battles were a joy to watch. You have a real talent, and I don't just mean commanding Digimon. Your matches are exciting. It's a shame you can't enter the tournament again. Thanks for everything!

english: First time in the DWM Tournament? I don't know who you are, but you'll be fine! Don't worry about what comes next. Jump in with both feet!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: You won that easily? Bronze Master already... Not that I'm jealous!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Silver Master already? You keep winning, but the DWM Tournament isn't supposed to be this easy! ...It isn't, right? I thought so...
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Gold Master? I can't even call it luck or cheating. You may not know this, but the team you just beat once saved the Digital World. Then again, you did too, didn't you?
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Platinum Master already? You face everything head-on with those bright eyes, and you keep winning. Watching you makes me want to try living more positively, and I hate that. I don't like regretting what I should've done. It's not your fault. I'm angry at myself.
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Legend Master? A legend, already? No way! That's a rank for someone with one foot in the grave. You're practically newborn! Why am I getting so worked up?
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Haven't seen you before. First time at the DigiColosseum? Who are you a fan of? I'm a huge Sayo fan, a 'Sayoer'! Hard to say? Too forced? Say what you like about me, but don't insult Sayo!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: You're the new challenger? Even I, a veteran tournament watcher, was fooled by your innocent face. And you're already a Bronze Master! You don't look strong or clever, but maybe your kind grows fast. As a dedicated Sayoer, I'll be watching you!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Silver Master already? That was a fine fight, but now you might face Sayo. As a devoted Sayoer, I don't mind whether you win or lose. Just don't tarnish your match against her!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Gold Master? Congratulations. I never thought you'd beat Sayo so easily. I admit it was a good match, even as a devoted Sayoer!

english: Congratulations, Platinum Master! Why do you look surprised? Yes, I'm a Sayoer, but I'm a tournament watcher first. I can praise a good battle wherever I see one!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Legend Master? Congratulations from a devoted Sayoer! What's that got to do with it? Never mind. Well done, Sayo! ...Sorry, I meant Taiki. My mouth said Sayo on its own!

english: Welcome to the DigiColosseum, Taiki! I am Justimon, Digimon of justice! Now I'm also a tournament watcher of justice! Ha ha ha!

english: Bronze Master, Taiki! I knew you could do it. As a Digimon of justice, I always cheer for the side of justice! What if both sides are just? Well... the shinier side, perhaps?

english: Silver Master, Taiki! Silver is the color of justice. My body is mostly silver too. Did you want to know my name? Of course you did! Justimon, the silver Digimon of justice! Ha ha ha!
blocks.review_note: DigiColosseum spectator and mission dialogue. The Blue and Red flight leaders and destination variants are kept distinct; character, Digimon, and location names follow reviewed project terminology.

english: Gold Master, Taiki! I knew you'd succeed! I've watched many tournaments, and Xros Heart stands out. Perhaps your team is the greatest since the Digital World began... No, too soon to say. But everyone here has high hopes for you!

english: Platinum Master, Taiki! Your skill really is astonishing. You may go all the way! A new power awakens! I once entered the DigiColosseum myself, you know. The result was astonishing too... for a very different reason! Ha ha ha!

english: Legend Master at last, Taiki! Congratulations! That's the final rank here, but your battles are far from over. This is your first step toward greatness. Keep protecting peace and happiness across the Digital World! The fight for justice goes on! Ha ha ha!

english: Oh, the hero of Elestou Zone! We've met before. Don't you remember? I never thought you'd enter the DWM Tournament. I knew you were special! Of course I'll cheer for you! Good luck!

english: Bronze Master! You're 'The Bronze Master' from now on! Why so glum? Then how about 'Rank Number Five'? Why are you staring into the distance?
